decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep listed, and one year of results has not yet resolved its uncertainty, so the option stays open.
The air cooled condenser shares manufacturing and sales resources with the core business, so keeping it costs little while its market value is still unclear.
This second single-tube condenser overlaps with Product B and might later be merged into it, but there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
The tube liner is a low-cost service add-on that fits the firm's lifecycle service strategy, so the option is cheap to hold and has promising upside.
The customized air cooler line with several models fits the firm's focus on integrated custom solutions and has many paths to further investment, so it is worth keeping.
The tube end repair inserts support the spare parts and repair business at minimal holding cost, so keeping them preserves the option while demand becomes clearer.
